paite: Hinna thu, atung a kipan a ana omta, koute'n ka zak uh, ka mit ua ka muh uh, ka et kilkel ua, ka khut ua ka khoih uh,
heading: Hinna Thu

paite: huai hinna latsak in ahong omta a, koute'n ka mu uhi, huai tangtawn hinna, Pa kiang a-omleh koute kiang ah latsak a om noute kiang ah ka hon puang uhi;

huai koute'n ka muhsa uh leh ka zaksa uh mah noute kiang a ka puankhiak uh, huchi a noute'n leng koute toh kithuahna na neihtheihna ding un; koute kithuahna bel Pa toh a Tapa Jesu Khrist toh kithuahna ahi.
Noute na kipahna uh abukimna ding in hiai ka hon gelh uhi.
Huan thukhah akiang a kipan a ka zak uh na kiang ua ka hon hilhsawn uh hiai ahi; Pathian zaw vak ahi a, amah ah mial a-om kei hi.
heading: Pathian Vak Ahi

paite: Mial a om napi in amah ka kithuahpih chi lehang zuau i gen a, thutak i zui kei uhi.
Himahleh amah vak a a-om bang a eite leng vak a i omleh i kithuah chiat ua, huan a Tapa Jesu sisan in i khelhna tengteng ahon silsiangsak zel hi.
Khelhna ka nei kei chi lehang eimah leh eimah i kikhem a, eimah ah thutak a-om kei hi.
heading: Khelhna Thuphatawina

paite: I khelhnate thupha i tawileh i khelhnate ngaidam ding leh i diktatlouhna tengteng silsiang ding in amah amuanhuai in adiktat hi.
Thil ka hihkhial kei i chihleh amah zuauthei in i bawl ua, athu leng ei ah a-om kei hi.
